pending_part_2.voiceover_script: In Part 1, we explored the massive glowing sphere that hovered over a Soviet military base in 1989, but when investigators examined the impact site, the horrifying reality set in. Declassified documents recovered decades later revealed that the ground beneath the hovering anomaly had been instantly vitrified, turning ordinary soil into smooth, black glass across a thirty-meter radius. Radiation meters spiked off the charts, yet no radioactive isotopes were ever detected. Even more disturbing, military logs noted that all military personnel stationed at the perimeter suffered from identical, permanent memory gaps lasting exactly forty-two minutes—the exact duration the sphere hovered above them. To this day, military physicists have no explanation for how raw kinetic energy could instantly melt earth without heat. What did that sphere take from their minds?
